source: TRANSLATION shape, the practical stress test: the prompt embeds the complete 718-line demo_MBS_suspension.cpp (projectchrono/chrono src/demos/mbs, copy in source/), a full 9-body car (chassis + 4 double-wishbone-as-ChLinkDistance corners + TSDA spring-dampers + rear torque motors with a throttle/differential/DC-motor drivetrain law) of which roughly half is Irrlicht GUI to be recognized and dropped, plus two elements the prompt explicitly excludes for determinism (randomly placed obstacles; an asymmetric-friction contact callback). Spring compression anchored to the independent linearized force balance in oracle.py (motion ratio 0.4/0.85; agrees 2-3% at both stiffnesses); ride-height and drive bands calibrated on the pinned build and frozen

L3.desc: spring settles 0.0276 below its 0.85 rest length (force balance predicts 0.0276: corner load 368 N against k times the 0.4/0.85 motion ratio); a wrong k, mass, or anchor geometry moves it
chassis ride height after the 0.55 m drop (calibrated 0.4205); the stiff-spring case (0.4422) fails high, a car that fell through or bottomed out fails low
the car is SPAWNED at y = 1 and dropped (catches pre-settled spawns)
4x stiffer springs carry the same corner load at ~1/4 the compression: settle 0.0071 below rest (force balance 0.0069); an unmodified candidate (0.8224) fails low
the stiffer car rides HIGHER (calibrated 0.4422); the soft-spring ride (0.4205) fails low

throttle 0.3 through the translated drivetrain law reaches 17.01 m/s in 8 s, approaching the 21.6 m/s DC-motor terminal; a mis-translated torque chain (dropped differential 0.5, wrong gear ratio) lands outside
the car actually drives (calibrated 81.13 m; a no-drive or feeble-torque candidate fails)
forward progress is monotonic under constant throttle

the car still rides at the stiff-suspension height while driving (calibrated 0.4369; band sized to the contention-level variance of the threaded contact solver, see CONTRACT.md): catches bottoming out or leaving the ground
